regions.merged_text: Pvt. Robert George - 19 - now 9 months in service - escaped from battle of Iwojima - lay three days in front line after being wounded - is able to walk now .... said to have been miraculous escape. Enrolled several times in Ser. Masses again To-day with comrades. . . .

regions.merged_text: Vincent Paul Minisci - 44 - operated in Mayo Clinic Rochester - had fearfully swollen leg. Wife made promise to give $100.00 for Poor Souls if things went well .... things did brighten some but not entirely .... she now fulfilles her Promise - hoping for fur- ther improvement - anxious of threatening operation.
